name: ina219
label: TI INA219: current, bus voltage and power monitor
description:
A shunt monitor on a high-side shunt: set the current, the bus voltage and the shunt resistor.
SHUNT_VOLTAGE follows the PGA range the DUT writes to CONFIGURATION (40 to 320 mV, it
saturates), BUS_VOLTAGE follows BRNG (16 or 32 V) and carries CNVR and OVF, and CURRENT and
POWER are computed from the CALIBRATION the DUT writes, as the part does (CURRENT = shunt
voltage x calibration / 4096, POWER = CURRENT x bus voltage / 5000; both 0 until the DUT writes
a calibration). CALIBRATION reads back with bit 0 clear. A reset (CONFIGURATION bit 15) reloads
the power-on image. CNVR does not clear when POWER is read.
